# Regression test for #35: sub-component widget fields must be declared on
# the Model struct. After NoInlineComponents, detailPanel is inlined into main
# rather than emitted as a separate renderDetailPanel method.

sngl generate --platform=fyne --lang=go --out=out app.sngl
exists out/model.go

# detailPanel gets inlined — no renderDetailPanel method survives.
! grep 'renderDetailPanel' out/model.go

# The inlined detailPanel's four text() nodes become Model fields.
# __n2 is the inlined vbox; __n3..__n6 are the four labels.
grep '__n2 \*fyne\.Container' out/model.go
grep '__n3 \*widget\.Label' out/model.go
grep '__n4 \*widget\.Label' out/model.go
grep '__n5 \*widget\.Label' out/model.go
grep '__n6 \*widget\.Label' out/model.go

# Prop references are substituted with m.current (the callsite arg).
grep 'm\.current\.Key' out/model.go
grep 'm\.current\.Summary' out/model.go
grep 'm\.current\.Status' out/model.go
grep 'm\.current\.Assignee' out/model.go

-- app.sngl --
output { go { fyne } }

struct Issue {
    key string
    summary string
    status string
    assignee string
}

component main {
    var current = Issue{}

    window #app(title="t") {
        vbox {
            text(value="header")
            detailPanel(it=current)
        }
    }
}

component detailPanel(it Issue) {
    vbox {
        text(value=it.key)
        text(value=it.summary)
        text(value=it.status)
        text(value=it.assignee)
    }
}
